properties.summary: Simplest durable profile: PostgreSQL is state, queue, and payload store.
properties.reason: PostgreSQL is the source of truth and the protocol-v1 acceptance barrier.
properties.orderingNote: run_at ordering per endpoint; no strict global ordering.
properties.failureRecovery: crash before commit returns retryable 503; no false acceptance.

acknowledgementBarrier.reason: Ingest, ledger, payload, and dispatch job commit in one transaction.

durableProtocolV1Acknowledgement.reason: 202 is returned only after the four artifacts are durable.

restartRecovery.reason: Committed state and pending reservations recover after restart.

durableIdempotency.reason: Idempotency ledger is durable for the full retry horizon.

leaseFencing.reason: Database-clock leases with fencing tokens prevent stale settlement.

multiReplicaSafe.reason: SKIP LOCKED claims allow multiple API/worker replicas.

replayRedrive.reason: Dead jobs are surfaced and redriven by explicit operator action.

requirements.backupRequirement: PostgreSQL physical or logical backup of the cell database.
